name: 参加可能性を添えた担当候補
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Lighthouse component LH11-0006 参加可能性を添えた担当候補: the open candidate-selection dropdown panel alone. Image1 ORIGINAL Deputy source has priority for checkbox geometry, avatar optical proportions, grouping, alignment, padding, status dot and small-control anatomy. Image2 rough Japanese mock is SECONDARY content guide; do not copy its missing status dot, mint action fill or undersized left-only footer button. Image3 approved bus is white-elevation style only.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas, single compact rounded white dropdown card with fine neutral border, soft downward shadow and small original-style top anchor notch. Logical640x252 proportions at high resolution; avoid excess height. First group heading 「おすすめの担当者」 at left, forest-green text action 「全員を選択（1）」 at right. Row: EMPTY small square checkbox, neutral circular avatar 「山」, regular name 「山田 太郎」 and right-aligned metadata 「18時間」. Second group heading 「調整が必要な担当者」, same 「全員を選択（1）」 right. Row: EMPTY checkbox, neutral avatar 「佐」, regular name 「佐藤 花子」, right metadata 「27時間」; below name a SMALL AMBER DOT followed by quiet 「担当が集中しています」, matching the original Stressed status anatomy and giving color its real status meaning. Bottom full-width footer control 「担当者を追加（0）」, as original full-width Add Team members(0), in a clearly DISABLED neutral-white/light-gray treatment with neutral outline and muted slate label; do not use an active green or mint fill when zero are selected.
Preserve exact two groups, two people, hour values, zero count, unchecked state and controls. No invented candidates or metrics. Meiryo regular body14/24, metadata12/16, zero tracking, restrained font weights, no huge title. Slate #526173 supporting details, neutral white avatars without mint fills. Original purple select-all links adapt to forest-green #1F6444; actual warning dot retains coherent amber #D19A20 with status text. No other colors or primary gradient on disabled action. All surfaces white, light neutral borders, calm depth, clean baselines, legible Japanese, no clipping. No surrounding invitation dialog or app chrome. Static raster candidate; no claim of real selection behavior.
reviewNotes: 原画優先で未選択チェック箱、二群、光学比率と上ノッチ、全幅の追加0無効面、黄色の負荷状態点を復元。氏名・18/27時間・選択1/追加0・注意文保持。紫リンクは森林緑、黄色は実際の負荷状態として保持、他中立。生成画像を実見し切れ/不足なし確認。正確な書体同定/寸法/実選択動作は未検証。画像レビューのみ。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
